## Merge PDFs

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-external">external engine</span><span>qpdf</span><span>progress</span></div>

Combine several PDFs into one document in the given order, optionally taking only some pages of each.

```sh
dogubako pdf merge <files…> [options]
```

Id `pdf.merge` · MCP `pdf_merge` · Output: files · Timeout 30 min

Also found by: combine, join, concatenate, append, pdf

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | PDF files (in order). Accepts .pdf. |
| `ranges` | `--ranges` | text (multi-line) |  | Optional: one page range per line, in file order (e.g. '1-3,5' or 'z-1'); blank line = all pages. *Advanced.* |
| `output_name` | `--output-name` | text | `merged.pdf` | Output file name. *Advanced.* |

## Split PDF

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-external">external engine</span><span>qpdf</span><span>progress</span></div>

Split a PDF into several files: every N pages, single pages, or custom page ranges.

```sh
dogubako pdf split <file> [options]
```

Id `pdf.split` · MCP `pdf_split` · Output: files · Timeout 30 min

Also found by: separate, burst, pages, divide, pdf

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | file |  | PDF. Accepts .pdf. |
| `mode` | `--mode` | choice | `every` | One of: `every` (Every N pages), `single` (Single pages), `ranges` (Custom ranges). |
| `every` | `--every` | integer 1–100000 | `1` | Pages per file. Only used when `mode` is `every`. |
| `ranges` | `--ranges` | text (multi-line) |  | One output file per group; separate groups with ';' or new lines, e.g. '1-3; 4-6; 7-z'. Only used when `mode` is `ranges`. |

| `allow` | `--allow` | list of choices | `print,copy` | Allowed actions. Any of: `print`, `modify` (Modify content), `copy` (Copy text & images), `annotate` (Add comments), `forms` (Fill in forms), `assemble` (Assemble (insert, rotate, delete pages)). |
